commit.message:
feat: Implement comprehensive RAG database, vector store system, and deployment infrastructure

Major Features Added:
- Complete vector store abstraction layer supporting ChromaDB, Elasticsearch, Pinecone, Weaviate, OpenSearch, ClickHouse
- Document processing pipeline with NLP preprocessing, entity extraction, and chunking
- Enhanced search and retrieval system with unified search interface and result aggregation
- Comprehensive monitoring and health checking system with anomaly detection
- Full API implementation with FastAPI including advanced endpoints for model management and analytics
- Kubernetes deployment configuration with auto-scaling and monitoring
- Development environment automation with Docker Compose
- CI/CD pipeline with comprehensive testing and deployment scripts

Components:
- Vector Store System: Abstract base classes with factory pattern for multiple vector databases
- NLP Pipeline: spaCy integration, entity extraction, document preprocessing, embedding strategies
- Search Engine: Unified search interface, result aggregation, query optimization
- Monitoring: Prometheus metrics, Grafana dashboards, enhanced health checks, anomaly detection
- API: FastAPI with comprehensive endpoints for search, document management, system operations
- Deployment: Kubernetes manifests, Docker configurations, monitoring stack
- Documentation: Comprehensive SRS, deployment guides, development documentation

Infrastructure:
- Multi-environment support (dev/staging/prod)
- Horizontal pod autoscaling
- Persistent storage configuration
- Service mesh ready
- Health check endpoints
- Metrics collection and alerting
- Backup and recovery systems

This implementation provides a production-ready RAG system with enterprise-grade monitoring,
scalability, and maintainability features.
